categorical_shapes.DIRECTIONLESS_ATTENTION: No fresh full dual-book alignment occurs before normalization or reset.
categorical_shapes.SAME_DIRECTION_PERSISTENCE: A provisional alignment occurs and persists or repeats without an opposite full-alignment recoil.
categorical_shapes.IGNITION_ONLY: A provisional alignment occurs, then causally crests or becomes mixed without opposite full alignment or renewed original alignment.
categorical_shapes.IGNITION_RECOIL: A provisional alignment is followed by opposite fresh full alignment, but the original direction does not return before termination.
categorical_shapes.IGNITION_RECOIL_REACCELERATION: A provisional alignment is followed by opposite fresh full alignment and later renewed original full alignment inside the same complete sub-10x episode.
categorical_shapes.MIXED_TORSION: Alignment or flow signs alternate without a complete ignition-recoil-reacceleration order.

categorical_precedence: No full dual-book alignment before terminal is DIRECTIONLESS_ATTENTION.
First provisional direction followed by opposite full alignment and later renewed original full alignment is IGNITION_RECOIL_REACCELERATION.
First provisional direction followed by opposite full alignment without renewed original full alignment is IGNITION_RECOIL.
Without full opposite alignment, any opposite single-book alignment or signed-flow sign reversal is MIXED_TORSION.
Without torsion, a later repeated original full alignment is SAME_DIRECTION_PERSISTENCE.
Every remaining provisionally aligned path is IGNITION_ONLY; a causal three-lower-observation crest is evidence inside the shape, not a separate threshold or label.
